rebaseline.authorizedVia: PR #709 R2 resolution — user selected 're-baseline on gate platform'
rebaseline.rationale: Original baseline (2491ms) was measured on win32-x64 (2026-10-22) and compared against Ubuntu DEBUG CI as a cross-platform regression alarm. ADR-0011 R2 (TS FileLock -> IndexWriteLease atomic switch) was proven to have ZERO net effect on the measured rust-hybrid index hot path (the only hot-path code change vs R1 was removing a redundant finalizeRustIndex acquire that, in R1, was a microsecond PID-file write). The +18.3% gate failure was the win32-x64-vs-Ubuntu-DEBUG platform gap plus run-to-run runner variance (R1's Ubuntu run happened to land under 15%; R2's two Ubuntu runs measured a stable ~2948ms median, just over). Re-baselining to the gate platform re-anchors the regression alarm to current like-for-like reality; future code regressions above 2948 * 1.15 = ~3390ms will still alarm.
